items.lede: Amazon-owned Ring is entering the smart lock market with a device designed to tackle a common concern: getting locked out when the battery dies.
items.title: Ring’s first smart lock can be hand-cranked when its battery dies

items.lede: Ring's smart lock has a built-in hand crank to generate power when the batteries are dead.
items.title: Ring's smart lock has a hand crank so it works even if the power's out

items.lede: The brand just announced a smart lock with a manual ‘power dial’ that charges the device in case it dies.
